name: one-arm-dumbbell-front-raise-on-incline-bench.html
instructions:
1. Grab a dumbbell and sit on the end of a bench while maintaining a straight back.
2. Inhale, brace your abs and raise your arm vertically while holding the dumbbell with a pronated grip. Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
3. Once your arm is parallel with the floor, slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, and then repeat on the other arm.
